history.summary: FLAG - UNCERTAIN IDENTITY: 'Shitla Sthan' is a generic name; several shrines of this name exist in Bhagalpur district (Shital Prasad Lane/Tati Tola at 25.224559, 86.976376; Tilkamanjhi-Champanagar Road at 25.251672, 86.998357; Devi Mandap Lane/Laluchak at 25.252524, 86.935804; a Justdial-listed Shitla Sthan at Makanpur), and no documented history was found for any specific one. This file uses the Sheetla Sthan Chowk locality (Ishakchak-Shitala Sthan, Mirjanhat, Bhagalpur 812001) - the city-centre referent - as the most likely candidate, with street-level geocoded coordinates; the identity match is unverified. Shitala is worshipped as the goddess of healing who cures ailments and protects devotees from diseases. No founding date, timings, or architectural details are documented for this shrine.

town_description: Bhagalpur is a major city on the southern bank of the Ganges in eastern Bihar and the historic capital of the Anga mahajanapada; it is known as India's 'Silk City' for its tussar-silk industry.

travel.airport: Bhagalpur has no commercial airport; the main gateway is Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, Patna (~230 km).
travel.railway: Bhagalpur Junction is the nearest major railway station (Eastern Railway).
travel.road: Well connected by road via NH-80 to Patna and neighbouring cities.
